result.rationale: The model validates `:host` with a regex permitting `(:[0-9]{1,5})?`, and `before_validation` only strips the scheme (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`) and path — a port survives into the stored host. `record_for_host` then queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` using `uri.host`, which per Ruby's URI never includes a port. So a row saved as 'example.com:8080' can never match any referer; the mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff and the controller happily persists such input.
